questions.question: When was the fatigue and sleep disturbance first reported?
What medications were prescribed or adjusted around the time fatigue and sleep issues began?
Were any investigations ordered for fatigue or insomnia, such as CBC, thyroid function, or sleep study?
Has the patient reported similar symptoms in the past, and if so, what was the assessment or management?
Was a mental health screen (e.g., PHQ-9, GAD-7) performed given fatigue and sleep disturbance?
Are there documented social, occupational, or lifestyle factors contributing to fatigue or poor sleep?
